title: Changing the multiplicity on a set of locally finite measure preserves weighted approximate tangent spaces almost everywhere
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ and H := μHE[k] on ℝ^N = Eucl N. Let E ⊆ ℝ^N be H-null-measurable with H(E ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^N, and let θ, θ′ : ℝ^N → ℝ both be H-integrable on E ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^N, with θ > 0 on E (no sign condition on θ′). Then for H-a.e. x ∈ E (H⌞E-almost every x) and every linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^N: if Q is a weighted approximate tangent space of (E, θ) at x (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k E θ x Q, Simon Ch. 3, 1.7), then Q is a weighted approximate tangent space of (E, θ′) at x.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (E : Set (Eucl N)) (θ θ' : Eucl N → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet E (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) (E ∩ K) < ∞) → (∀ x ∈ E, 0 < θ x) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (E ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ' (E ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict E), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl N), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k E θ x Q → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k E θ' x Q
